title: Missed-Appointment Credit Extra Within the Reschedule Allowance
content:
**Northgate Store and Online Orders.** The missed-appointment credit on a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order carries an extra percentage measured by the customer's own confirmed reschedule requests already on the order against the program's free reschedules, which number 2 for Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery (0 in every other program):

| Confirmed customer reschedule requests on the order | Extra percentage |
|---|---|
| no higher than the free reschedules (2 or fewer) | 10 percent |
| exactly one above them (3) | 5 percent |
| two or more above them (4 or more) | nothing |

**Basis question.** *Does a customer who has never asked to reschedule receive the extra?* Yes: a count of 0 is no higher than the free reschedules and adds 10 percent.
